name: 👻 Ghost Carve
desc: THE one. Carves the Ghost Fracture color-shift contract into ANY base: the pattern becomes env-mirror cells (CC swings 64↔240), metal lobe untouched. Ritual: base + pattern + this mode + crush color near black + daytime track — the pattern flashes sky-teal/sun-gold by angle on any finish/combo.

name: 🪞 Chrome Inlay
desc: Dielectric mirror inlay where the pattern is hot: metal dips, clearcoat ceilings, gloss floors (the blue-insight recipe). Hardest possible env flash — pattern reads as pure chrome inlays.

name: ❄ Frost Etch
desc: Pattern sandblasts the gloss: roughness way up, metal slightly down. Etched areas go milky in sun while the rest stays mirror — reads like acid-etched glass.

name: 🔄 Angle Flip
desc: Pattern hot areas get metal-flash physics; the NEGATIVE SPACE gets mirror-flash physics. The pattern appears at one viewing angle and INVERTS at another. Nobody else has this.

name: 🔥 Ember Gate
desc: Only the pattern's top ridges ignite (clearcoat pinned near max + gloss floor): sparkle ignition along edges, calm everywhere else. Best with patterns that have strong peaks.

name: 🗜 Depth Press
desc: Emboss in spec only: every pattern element gets a lit rim and a shadow rim — the pattern reads STAMPED INTO the paint at speed, without touching the paint itself.
